items.title: Traits are not attacks
items.body: Descriptive abilities (like Wild Card) no longer show up as physical attacks in a fight; only skills that sound like an attack do, or ones the AI labels.

items.title: Locked base values
items.body: Base stats, Persona stats and affinities can no longer be changed by accident: press the lock to edit them by hand. HP/SP and spending level points work as before.

items.title: Free time
items.body: Spend each time of day on an activity or a Confidant from the Calendar tab: the line goes in the chat box, the effects apply when you send it. A Persona of the Confidant's Arcana gives a stronger bond; after a dungeon you only rest.

items.title: Fusion bonus as XP
items.body: The Confidant of the Arcana now gives the fused Persona XP (about three levels at rank 10).

items.title: Experience, Persona-style
items.body: A level every ~5 fights against enemies of your level (the first ones faster); enemies give XP by their own level; story awards are a share of your level.

items.title: Personas grow on their own
items.body: A Wild Card's Persona earns the fight's XP and can pass your level; the others only with Growth. Teammates move together with their Persona.

items.title: Change Persona in battle
items.body: A Wild Card can switch Persona on their turn — free, once a turn.
